detail: ArMee Infotech Limited has raised ₹300 crore through an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of 8,000,000 equity shares. Luthra and Luthra Law Offices India advised ArMee Infotech as well as the book running lead managers Khandwala Securities Limited and Saffron Capital Advisors Private Limited on this IPO. The transaction team consisted of Akshit Kapoor (Partner), Kshitij Asthana (Managing Associate), Associates Manali Singh, Swetapadma Priyadarshini, Ashwin Singh, Karan Kapoor, Savar Arora, Kumar Anant Ashish and Shashwat Tyagi.
